source: Kevin Xu (@kevinxu) public rules for *execution*. Quality checklist is separate: config/ackman-quality-screen.json. All-in one equity; no margin/options/crypto/pennies; vibes + support + catalyst; don't chase; sell 20–30% / before rumor is news; no stops. He traded GME early: meme/retail names are allowed if not a chase.

preEarningsRunUp.note: Xu: if the street expects a good Q, the stock often runs BEFORE the print. Sell into that +20–30%. Do not need the actual earnings night. The print is a coin flip — holding it is optional only if still below target AND setup intact; default is sell before rumor becomes the 8-K.

rules.hardStopNote: Xu: no stop-losses. Exit = target, screenshot, rumor-is-news, or setup dead.

setupChecklist: Listed common stock — not options, not crypto, not a penny that can go to zero overnight
Retail attention / vibes building (Reddit, X, scanners) — Xu is terminally online, not DCF
Buy near support — do not chase a name that already ran
Pre-Q run-up is a valid swing: expected-good print → drift up in the days before → sell 20–30% BEFORE the report
Do not YOLO the earnings print for the extra %
Worst case on a real stock is typically an ugly gap (~20–25%), not zero
passIf: Already ran hard into the catalyst (chase) — including already +20% into a Q with the print still ahead (too late, that WAS the move)
Penny / OTC / can go to zero overnight
Needs options, crypto, or margin to work
Horizon is 3–12 months with no near-term swing
Would require a second simultaneous name
